trust_decision.summary: Option objects are trusted to carry only own properties: every place that reads an option is assumed to find it on the caller's object itself, so a polluted Object.prototype can supply a worker filename that the pool then dynamically imports. The fix enforces the trust by copying options onto a null-prototype object at each read boundary (src/common.ts withNullPrototype, applied in the ThreadPool defaults merge, ThreadPool.recycleWorkers, the Tinypool constructor and Tinypool.run).

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names run() options, and run() is where the option object is destructured for filename/name/signal before being handed to ThreadPool.runTask.
